# ADAM v1.0 Production Boundary

## Complete in this package

The bounded software mechanisms, security controls, qualification controllers, trust registries, launchers, tests, wheel and signed release manifest are implemented and executable.

## Not creatable by software alone

The following are real-world evidence requirements and are intentionally not marked complete by this package:

- Hardware-backed, non-exportable authority keys
- Key ceremonies and disaster recovery on selected HSM/KMS providers
- Fault testing across physically independent hosts and networks
- Functional-safety approval for actual devices
- Rights-cleared large-scale training and independent held-out evaluation
- Thirty real elapsed days under a frozen candidate and predefined SLOs
- Independent penetration, source, safety and operational certification

The assurance layer blocks production promotion until these gates contain immutable evidence and, where required, independent verification.
